payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Hopper (H20 / H100 / H200 / SM90): Practical Experience

problem.statement: DSM Crossover FP8 Dequantization -- Practical Experience

payload.what: - DSM crossover doubles dequantization throughput (2 CTAs dequantize in parallel), making dequantization no longer the bottleneck - `st.async` is key: asynchronous writes do not block computation, enabling overlap between dequantization and WGMMA - Cluster Size must be 2 (larger clusters increase scheduling complexity with diminishing returns) - This pattern can be generalized to any "preprocessing → matrix multiplication" scenario where preprocessing is the bottleneck
